body:
When a lock forks on the Python version, `uv lock --upgrade` (or locking with no `uv.lock` yet) writes a dependency edge whose marker can never be true: ```toml { name = "beta", version = "2.0", source = { ... }, marker = "python_version < '0'" } ``` A plain `uv lock` that has to re-resolve against the existing lock, for example after the project's own `version` changed, writes the same resolution without that edge. Each form accepts the other's lockfile (`--dry-run` reports no changes), so a project whose tooling runs both gets the same one-line diff in `uv.lock` back and forth. We hit it on every release of a project where the release step re-locked with plain `uv lock` and the test step with `uv lock --upgrade`; in that project the dead edge is `build`'s dependency on `importlib-metadata` (`python_full_version < '3.10.2'`) inside the `>= 3.11` fork. Seen with uv 0.13.0 and 0.13.10 on x86_64 Linux. ### Reproduction (offline, generated wheels) ``` alpha 1.0 Requires-Dist: beta; python_full_version < '3.10.2' gamma 1.0 Requires-Dist: beta>=2; python_version >= '3.11' beta 1.0 beta 2.0 Requires-Python: >=3.11 ``` ```toml [project] name = "demo" version = "1.0.0" requires-python = ">=3.10" dependencies = ["alpha", "gamma"] [tool.uv] find-links = [""] no-index = true ``` 1. `uv lock` with no lockfile: alpha's dependencies include `beta 2.0` with `marker = "python_version < '0'"`. 2. Set `version = "1.0.1"`, run `uv lock`: the edge is gone. 3. `uv lock --upgrade`: the edge is back. The lock forks at 3.11. In the `>= 3.11` fork alpha's `python_full_version < '3.10.2'` requirement can't hold, and the from-scratch path keeps the edge with the marker simplified to false instead of dropping it. ### Expected The same resolution gives the same lockfile whichever path produced it. I'd expect the edge to be left out, as the lock-guided path already does.
Script that builds the wheels and runs the three steps (python3 repro.py <empty dir>) ```python """Probe: do tiny local wheels reproduce uv's dead `python_version < '0'` edge? Usage: python3 fixture_probe.py Prints the dead-edge count after a fresh lock, after a version change + plain lock, and after --upgrade, so the bump/gate flip is visible. """ from __future__ import annotations import subprocess import sys import zipfile from pathlib import Path def wheel(dist: Path, name: str, version: str, requires: list[str], requires_python: str | None = None) -> None: tag = f"{name}-{version}" meta = [f"Metadata-Version: 2.1", f"Name: {name}", f"Version: {version}"] if requires_python: meta.append(f"Requires-Python: {requires_python}") meta += [f"Requires-Dist: {r}" for r in requires] files = { f"{name}/__init__.py": "", f"{tag}.dist-info/METADATA": "\n".join(meta) + "\n", f"{tag}.dist-info/WHEEL": "Wheel-Version: 1.0\nGenerator: probe\nRoot-Is-Purelib: true\nTag: py3-none-any\n", } record = "".join(f"{p},,\n" for p in files) + f"{tag}.dist-info/RECORD,,\n" with zipfile.ZipFile(dist / f"{tag}-py3-none-any.whl", "w") as zf: for path, text in files.items(): zf.writestr(path, text) zf.writestr(f"{tag}.dist-info/RECORD", record) def project(root: Path, version: str, links: Path) -> None: (root / "pyproject.toml").write_text( "[project]\n" 'name = "demo"\n' f'version = "{version}"\n' 'requires-python = ">=3.10"\n' 'dependencies = ["alpha", "gamma"]\n' "[tool.uv]\n" f'find-links = ["{links.as_posix()}"]\n' "no-index = true\n", encoding="utf-8", ) def dead(root: Path) -> int: return (root / "uv.lock").read_text(encoding="utf-8").count("python_version < '0'") def lock(root: Path, *args: str) -> None: subprocess.run(["uv", "lock", "-q", *args], cwd=root, check=True) def main() -> None: work = Path(sys.argv[1]) dist = work / "dist" dist.mkdir(parents=True) wheel(dist, "alpha", "1.0", ["beta; python_full_version < '3.10.2'"]) wheel(dist, "gamma", "1.0", ["beta>=2; python_version >= '3.11'"]) wheel(dist, "beta", "1.0", []) wheel(dist, "beta", "2.0", [], requires_python=">=3.11") root = work / "proj" root.mkdir() project(root, "1.0.0", dist) lock(root) print("fresh lock:", dead(root)) project(root, "1.0.1", dist) lock(root) print("version change + plain lock:", dead(root)) lock(root, "--upgrade") print("then --upgrade:", dead(root)) print((root / "uv.lock").read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if __name__ == "__main__": main() ``` Output with uv 0.13.10: ``` fresh lock: 1 version change + plain lock: 0 then --upgrade: 1 ```
title: `uv lock --upgrade` writes a dead edge (`python_version < '0'`) that a lock-guided `uv lock` drops, so uv.lock flips
